nodes.name: Every Hour
nodes.notes: One agency per run: the one synced longest ago.

nodes.name: Sync Now Webhook
nodes.notes: Settings → ASARI → Sync now. Answers at once; the result shows in Settings.

parameters.query:
-- 0044: the agency asked for, else the one synced longest ago; with what Elliot already has.
select * from asari_next_sync(nullif($1, '')::uuid);

nodes.name: Get Listing
nodes.notes: ASARI allows 25 calls a minute: one call every 2.6 seconds.

parameters.query:
-- Withdraws listings ASARI no longer exports and saves the result for Settings.
select asari_finish_sync($1::uuid, $2::jsonb, $3, $4::jsonb) as result;

meta.description: 0044: copies an agency's ASARI listings into Elliot, hourly (one agency per run) or on Sync now.
